full_context.description: Experiment: base prompt + full contribution text ($contribution_text) alongside the sibling-key-message list, so the model can ground relevance in the actual source text instead of just KM strings

relevance_gate.description: Experiment: base prompt restructured into an explicit two-step decision (relevant: true/false, then stance), with relevant=false forcing stance=NEUTRAL, plus two new few-shot examples mined from real annotated failures

full_context_relevance_gate.description: Experiment: combines full_context and relevance_gate -- full contribution text plus the explicit relevance-first decision structure
